entities.name: UniProt A1TD59
observations: Exact full-length sequence match (166/166 aa) to reviewed Mycolicibacterium vanbaalenii ATP synthase subunit b; annotated as a single-pass membrane protein and peripheral-stalk component linking F1 to F0.
ATP synthase subunit b contributes to coupling the F1 catalytic sector and F0 membrane sector during rotary proton-transport-driven ATP synthesis.
